text:
marta_cs: Hey team — NovaHealth onboarding is seeing a burst of 429s during SDK init. They reported heavy client-side parallelism on app start. Full thread and logs below.

liam_eng: Can you paste the init snippet + SDK version? Curious if it's the RN connector we patched last week.

marta_cs: SDK v1.4.2, snippet from their frontend:

ben_cs: @marta_cs drop the snippet inline

marta_cs: ```js
const client = Redwood.init({ key: process.env.RW_KEY });
Promise.all([client.embed(a), client.embed(b), client.embed(c)]) // app coldstart fanout
```

liam_eng: Ah — they're doing Promise.all on first paint. Combined with ephemeral-token TTL=3s we saw earlier, this causes token-refresh stampede + preflight fanout. Logs show repeated 401->retry->429 loops.

ben_cs: Their logs: "401 handshake failed" then 5 quick retries each 100ms — unsurprising.

marta_cs: Any short-term mitigations we can advise? Customer is blocking on launch tomorrow.

liam_eng: Recommend 3 things:
1) Client: replace Promise.all with sequenced splay (randomized micro-delay). Example:
```js
await Promise.all(items.map(async (it, i) => { await sleep(Math.random()*200 + i*50); return client.embed(it); }));
```
2) Increase token TTL on their side or use shared ephemeral between concurrent inits.
3) Server: enable preflight coalescing on gateway for this tenant for 24h (merge identical preflights for 250ms window).

sara_docs: I'll add a short playbook snippet to docs: "Onboard fanout: sequence, jitter, avoid simultaneous preflight." Link to edit: /docs/onboarding/fanout

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-6782 (preflight-throttle). Assigned: eng-runtime.

liam_eng: Also check HTTP/2 connection reuse — RN Webview sometimes opens many streams and kills keep-alive, so gateway sees +20 short-lived connections instead of reusing one. If they can't change client quickly, we can temporarily relax per-connection preflight limits for their IP pool.

ben_cs: Sent the mitigation guide to NovaHealth (splay + backoff). They asked for a concrete backoff config. Suggested:
```yaml
retries:
  initial: 200ms
  factor: 2
  jitter: 0.3
  max: 5
```

marta_cs: Customer applied the splay and reduced parallelism — 429s dropped to ~2/min within 15m. They want permanent docs update and a small SDK helper to avoid Promise.all on init.

sara_docs: I'll push docs PR with example code and a small helper util `redwood.splayInit()` by EOD.

liam_eng: I'll open a lightweight SDK patch to expose a throttled wrapper and add telemetry to flag preflight storms. PR => https://git.redwood/re/p/234

marta_cs: Thanks all, closing the urgent loop. Follow-ups: docs PR, SDK patch, and temporary gateway coalesce if needed.

ops-bot: INC-6782 updated: resolved -> monitoring.
